_readme: S668 SkyPipit, 2026-11-16. Run 43947867258 (_getHistoricalCatalogs) names this host's 2025-2026 catalog as Id 13. A prior-year read (CAPTURE_PRIOR) hears its catalog id from the start page's own calls, so this load checks that the archive view asks _getNavigation for 13 and not the active catalog, and prints its first navigation ids for the start address. One load, no model call.
